name: Scotts Farm Camping Site
accommodation: Grass tent and tourer pitches, with or without electric
suitableFor: Families, groups of campers and dog owners
dogs: Dogs welcome on leads; off-lead dog field and dog shower
beachAccess: About a ten-minute walk from East Wittering Beach
confirmedFeatures: Toilets and showers, laundry, Wi-Fi, shop, cafe, play areas, bike hire, beach trolleys; first-come first-served; open 1 March to 31 October
overview: A farm campsite at West Wittering about ten minutes' walk from East Wittering Beach. Pitches are grass, with or without electric, and there is a shop, cafe, laundry and play areas. It works on a first-come, first-served basis.
surfTripFit: Beach trolleys and a ten-minute walk to the sand suit campers bringing boards.
